title: Two water valves replaced at Chestnut and South Jarvis; crews backfilling to reopen the street
excerpt: City of Laredo Utilities crews have replaced two water valves at Chestnut Street and South Jarvis Avenue and are now backfilling the site so the street can reopen.
content:
City of Laredo Utilities crews have replaced two water valves at Chestnut Street and South Jarvis Avenue, the department said early Tuesday morning, November 11.

Crews will now start backfilling the work site to reopen the street, according to the department's update, posted at 1:12 a.m.

The department did not say how long the backfilling will take or give an exact time for the street to reopen. Drivers in the area should watch for crews and equipment while the work wraps up.

The valve work is part of the department's ongoing maintenance of the city's water system. Webb Watch covered separate valve work in District 2 on November 6.

Questions or concerns can be directed to 3-1-1.

For the full story — webbwatch956.com

Sources: City of Laredo Utilities Department, Nov. 11, 2026.
